description: Read one NHTSA owner safety complaint by its ODI number: vehicle, components, crash, fire, injuries and deaths reported, incident and filing dates, partial VIN and the owner's own description. For lawyers, investigators, journalists and owners following up a complaint found with vehicle_complaints. Source: NHTSA Office of Defects Investigation complaints. The account is the owner's own and is not verified by NHTSA. (cost: 1 credit)

odinumber.description: integer, required, NHTSA ODI complaint number, e.g. 11772096

name: complaint_by_odi_number
